factions.name: Clarity Incorporated
factions.description: Noah and Claire Atropos' megacorporation. Publicly a technology and logistics empire; privately it owns the city's illegal weapons trade, puppeteers most supervillains, and runs the Beast Conversion Program.
goals: Control Neo Terra from the shadows
Convert captured metahumans into obedient beast-infused assets
Eliminate metahumans and alien influence
Replace national borders with a corporate world order

factions.name: PetraByte
factions.description: Gintvilas Petrauskas' multi-trillion-dollar technology company, the public backbone of Neo Terra's superhero infrastructure. Its heir Vaiva operates as Colorgarde.
goals: Protect Neo Terra's people
Keep superhero infrastructure and communications running
Counter Clarity Incorporated
Shield metahumans from government control

factions.name: The Renya Clan
factions.description: A tribalist cult and terrorist organisation that wants to revert the world to a primal age without technology. Leila Renya leads it after stealing the Living Curse from its deity.
goals: Revert Neo Terra to a primal world
Corrupt Vaiva's allies into Renya-ized servants
Break the Superhero Social Network
Spread the Living Curse to every metahuman

factions.name: Midnight Treat
factions.description: Not a conventional organisation. Vireze Tylow, an ancient vampiress, gifts troubled civilians hypnotic powers and lets the resulting chaos spread. Her 'followers' are unwitting, disposable treats.
goals: Destabilise Neo Terra through distributed chaos
Hand power to ordinary, troubled people
Remain unseen and unaccountable
Make the heroes fight the city they protect

factions.name: Corvus Corp
factions.description: Monika Matic's fashion and materials empire, built on the supernatural mineral Monicium. It supplies superhero suits for free and funds city repairs and rehabilitation.
goals: Keep every superhero suited and operational
Protect the Monicium supply
Fund reconstruction and villain rehabilitation

factions.name: The Sensational Sirens
factions.description: Amy Matic's fashionable superhero team. Powerful, image-conscious, and morally flexible; its members range from genuine heroines to reformed villainesses.
goals: Dominate Neo Terra's superhero scene
Protect the city on their own terms
Advance Siren's Styles and the team's brand

factions.name: Neo Terra Police Department
factions.description: The city's overstretched police force. It coordinates with registered superheroes through the Superhero Social Network but is outmatched by metahuman crime.
goals: Keep public order
Contain metahuman incidents
Protect civilians from both villains and vigilantes

factions.name: Neo Terra Crisis Coalition
factions.description: A recurring, decentralised alliance of heroes, villains, vigilantes, cops, and civilians that forms during existential threats to the city.
goals: Stop existential threats to Neo Terra
Coordinate otherwise hostile factions
Protect civilians above old grudges
